response.overview: 80s DVD Jukebox is a 2003 various-artists music video compilation DVD (NTSC, all regions), part of a series that also included companion volumes like Get It On: The Seventies DVD Jukebox. All the videos were recorded at the German TV show Musik Laden, and the DVD includes special features consisting of an "80s fact-file" on each featured artist. It contains 24 original TV recordings in total.  The lineup spans the biggest and most memorable hits of the 1980s, including The Police, Spandau Ballet, Depeche Mode, Madness, Frankie Goes to Hollywood, Talk Talk, Robert Palmer, Wham!, Rod Stewart, OMD, Culture Club, and Duran Duran.
response.title: Various: 80s DVD Jukebox
